When partition and famine hit Bengal, this one plant saved the lives of millions! The humble Kochu or Arbi, a staple in Bengali kitchens. Its roots, stems, leaves, all became nutrition, when there was none!
And in Episode 3 of India’s Lost Recipes, we explore the depths of Bengali food beyond
‘Maacher Jhol’ with !
